column1: # The character sheet as the client itself displays it, build 16042.
# Source: three screenshots of the Display: Stats panel plus the paperdoll, Channa Silverthorn,
# level 50, NO GEAR EQUIPPED. Taken 2026-08-14 and supplied by the player. This is the CLIENT, not a
# capture of it, so where this disagrees with anything else this wins (CLAUDE.md rule 7b).
# THIS IS THE DEFINITIVE LIST OF STATS THAT EXIST IN 16042. If a stat is not on this sheet it is not
# a live stat, whatever the tables or an API reference say. Brutality, Finesse, Moxie, Tech, Insight
# and Grit are absent and are confirmed legacy - independently, no ability among the 202 scales off
# THE NAKED BASELINE IS THE ZERO POINT. Every value here is what the character has with nothing
# equipped, so any scaling measurement starts from these numbers and a coefficient derived from a
# geared capture must reduce to these when the gear comes off.
# ASSAULT POWER AND SUPPORT POWER ARE BOTH 225 ON THIS CHARACTER. That matters more than it looks:
# an AssaultPower coefficient and a SupportPower coefficient produce IDENTICAL contributions here,
# so a single naked capture cannot tell them apart. Anything claiming to have separated them from
# Channa alone has not. They must be moved independently - which is what !entity setprop and
